Foundation Foods "Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat, with added vitamin D" fdc_id 322892; ug-unit anchor. Replaces the salmon anchor: neither salmon entry in this Foundation Foods release (fdc_id 2684440 wild caught, 2684441 farm raised) carries a vitamin_d value at all, so the golden check could never pass against it. US vitamin-D-fortified milk is federally standardized at ~100IU (2.5ug) per 244g cup, i.e. ~1.0ug/100g, matching the measured figure closely -- a tighter, more reliable anchor than diet-variable fish. Deliberate deviation from the design spec, which named salmon vitamin D as the anchor food: that food genuinely has no vitamin_d figure in this release, so the spec's named anchor could never have passed.
